title: Marketing & Operations Intern
skills: Supporting day-to-day budget administration and financial workflows by preparing and tracking purchase requests and purchase orders, following up on procurement and invoice status, and keeping supporting documentation accurate and up to date.

Strong organizational and project-coordination skills, with the ability to manage different priorities, maintain accurate information, pay attention to detail, meet deadlines, and consistently follow through on assigned tasks.

Descripción de la empresa

Se espera que el sector Automotriz del grupo Continental se convierta en una empresa independiente bajo el nombre de “AUMOVIO” en septiembre de 2025. Con aproximadamente 93,000 empleados en todo el mundo y ventas anuales de alrededor de 20 mil millones de euros, estamos entrando en una nueva y emocionante era.

AUMOVIO representa productos electrónicos altamente desarrollados y soluciones modernas de movilidad. Además de su sólida posición en el mercado con soluciones innovadoras de sensores, pantallas, sistemas de freno y confort tecnológicamente avanzados, AUMOVIO cuenta con una experiencia significativa en software, plataformas de arquitectura y sistemas de asistencia para el mercado en rápido crecimiento de vehículos definidos por software y autónomos. Nuestro propósito es claro: hacer que la movilidad del futuro sea segura, emocionante, conectada y autónoma.

Descripción del empleo

Como parte de la estrategia para fortalecer la identidad de AUMOVIO y aumentar el engagement de los colaboradores, se solicita el reemplazo del puesto de becario de Comunicación que apoye la ejecución de campañas, producción de contenidos y actividades orientadas a cultura organizacional y experiencia del empleado.

Brindar al estudiante experiencia práctica en comunicación interna, diseño gráfico, creación de contenido, gestión de campañas y activaciones para colaboradores, contribuyendo al fortalecimiento de la cultura organizacional y la marca AUMOVIO.

Desarrollo de materiales visuales y campañas internas para fortalecer la cultura y la identidad de AUMOVIO.
Diseño gráfico de comunicados , contenidos digitales para pantallas y redes sociales y materiales promocionales.

Creación de contenido audiovisual y apoyo en cobertura de eventos internos.
Soporte en iniciativas de comunicación interna y experiencia del empleado.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:

Our client is a digital marketing agency serving primarily automotive and local service businesses, including detailing, window tinting, and ceramic coating companies. The agency helps its clients grow through Google Ads, websites, SEO, Meta Ads, CRM and email nurturing, video editing, and other marketing services.

As its portfolio grows, the agency is looking for a proactive professional who can take ownership of both campaign performance and the client experience.

The Opportunity

This is a true hybrid role: roughly half hands-on Google Ads management and half Client Success and Account Management.

You will own approximately 20-25 client relationships and their Google Ads accounts, representing roughly USD $100,000 in combined monthly ad spend. You'll deliver campaign results and communicate strategy directly to clients, taking day-to-day campaign and account management off the founder's plate.

As the agency scales, this position may evolve into a dedicated Client Success role, with Google Ads execution moving to a separate specialist.

What You'll Do

Google Ads Management


Personally manage lead-generation Google Search campaigns end to end, including campaign builds, high-intent keyword research, responsive search ads, geographic targeting, budgets, bidding, negative keywords, testing, and ongoing optimization
Implement, test, and troubleshoot conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager, Google Tag Assistant, and Google Ads, and verify that leads are accurately captured and attributed in the CRM (including GoHighLevel where used)
Conduct systematic account audits and monitor CTR, CPC, search impression share, conversion rate, CPL, budget pacing, and lead quality
Document findings, adjustments, and next steps, and proactively resolve performance issues


Client Success and Account Management


Own relationships with approximately 20-25 clients, holding proactive check-ins about every two weeks
Explain results and translate marketing data into practical business recommendations
Track client health, spot dissatisfaction and churn risks early, lead recovery conversations, and support client retention
Coordinate with website, SEO, Meta Ads, CRM, and other delivery specialists to resolve client issues and follow through on commitments
Advise clients on growth opportunities and relevant agency services when appropriate (there is no formal upsell quota)
Maintain timely client communication, clear account notes, accurate CRM records, and organized project follow-up
Improve reporting, handoffs, client communication practices, and repeatable processes as the business scales


What Success Looks Like


Strong client retention, supported by a simple Green / Yellow / Red account-health view and early escalation of at-risk clients
Proactive client check-ins approximately every two weeks, and responses to client messages within 24 hours on business days
Google Search campaigns that meet the agency's performance standards, with close monitoring of lead-generation efficiency and CPL by service
Accurate conversion tracking and CRM lead flow, plus documented account reviews and improvements
Clear, actionable account reporting, prompt escalation of material performance or tracking issues, and documented follow-through on corrective actions
By day 90, independent ownership of campaign delivery and client communication without routine founder involvement


Your First 90 Days


Days 1-30: Learn the agency's Google Ads standards, client portfolio, systems, and team workflows. Shadow founder-led client calls and begin taking ownership of assigned accounts
Days 31-60: Manage a growing share of the portfolio independently, establish consistent client communication and account-health tracking, and demonstrate reliable campaign oversight
Days 61-90: Take end-to-end ownership of Google Ads and client relationships with minimal supervision, proactively address performance and retention risks, and identify relevant expansion opportunities


Compensation

Base compensation is up to USD $4,000 per month, depending on experience and location.

PTO, holidays, and benefits depend on location and final terms.

10% comision on any Upsell generated

description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a data-driven, highly organized Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist to join our Marketplace team and report to the Product Manager for Marketplace. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

The Marketplace is where shoppers discover stores, products, and deals inside the Sezzle app. Our team runs a lot of features, and there's almost always something being tested. You'll be the person who knows what's live, who it's live for, and how it's performing.

This is an operations role with a strong product and data lens. You'll launch and track A/B tests, keep an eye on our shopping partners, and turn results into clear recommendations on what we do next. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, design, and partnerships. If you like running a lot of experiments at once and keeping every one of them organized, this role is for you.

The salary range for this role is $2,000 - $2,666 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Experimentation


Set up, QA, and launch A/B tests across Marketplace features. Make sure targeting, variants, and tracking are right before anything goes live.
Monitor running tests, flag issues early, and call results once they reach significance.
Keep a single source of truth for every test: what's live, who sees it, and what we learned.


Partner & Marketplace Operations


Create and manage placements, promotions, coupons, and offers across the Sezzle app.
Set up and manage cashback programs in our internal admin tools.
Onboard new online stores into the marketplace and activate their store domains, so more stores are shoppable in the app.

Document test plans, results, and processes, and find parts of the workflow that can be automated with AI.


Required

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
1 to 3+ years of experience in operations, experimentation, or product analytics.

Clear written and verbal communication in English, with teammates across the business and external partners.
Strong analytical skills. Comfortable with SQL and dashboards, and able to read A/B test results (lift, significance, sample size).
Comfortable in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift.
Detail-oriented with a QA mindset. You catch the targeting mistake before it launches. 
Daily user of Claude or a similar AI tool. You use it to analyze data, write queries, draft docs, and automate repetitive work, and you can walk us through real examples.

Experience with Jira and Confluence.

description:
👋 About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we’re blending technology and real-world expertise to empower businesses across the U.S. like never before. We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That’s why we’re on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and, above all, grow sustainably without the hassle.

The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it’s no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations and contact management, drive leads, stabilize cash flow, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can reclaim their time to focus on what they do best.

🌎 Our Vision

We aim to be the ultimate all-in-one platform for small business growth, allowing owners to manage every part of their business efficiently and effortlessly. Our journey began as an agency, and we’ve already helped thousands of clients succeed. Now, we’re embracing an exciting new chapter: becoming a SaaS-first company. By combining hard-earned human expertise with AI and automation, we’re creating affordable solutions that give business owners peace of mind while driving measurable success.

🫵 Why We Need You

Are you passionate about the intersection of emerging AI technology, social media marketing, and empowering small businesses’ online presence?

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and design-savvy Junior Social Media Specialist to join our team at Olly Olly. In this role, you will be the critical human touchpoint bridging artificial intelligence and real-world brand representation. Rather than writing content from scratch, you will partner with Olly AI—our proprietary content generation engine—to review, refine, and lay out high-performing posts across diverse small business profiles.

Managing a dynamic portfolio of 225+ small business clients, you will ensure every account receives on-brand, error-free monthly content delivered accurately and on schedule.

A successful Jr. Social Media Specialist at Olly Olly combines sharp visual aesthetics, meticulous editorial review, excellent time management, and a strong understanding of how local businesses connect with their communities.

🚀 The Impact You’ll Have


Publishing Pipeline & Portfolio Ramp: Lay out, schedule, and publish monthly social media schedules across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn. You will participate in a structured ramp-up process, starting at 100 to 150 accounts and scaling up to manage a full portfolio of 225+ clients with consistent, on-time delivery. 
AI Campaign Alignment & Quality Assurance: Review and adapt Olly AI–generated campaigns to ensure every post aligns with the client’s industry, local marketing objectives, and brand voice before going live. 
Cross-Functional Team Collaboration: Work in tight synergy with internal client-facing partners—including Account Managers and Account Coordinators—to quickly action feedback, address revisions, and maintain high client retention. 
Platform Standards & Template Innovation: Track evolving social platform guidelines, dimensions, and algorithm changes; propose layout and template adjustments to ensure Olly AI content formats cleanly and delivers peak engagement for local businesses. 


✅ What We Really Need From You


Experience: 1–2 years of experience in social media management, digital marketing, or digital production (agency or high-volume account management experience is a major plus). 
High-Volume Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational capacity, pipeline management skills, and comfort managing deadlines across 200+ distinct accounts simultaneously. 
Editorial & Visual Eye: Strong aesthetic sense for post layouts and typographic hierarchy, paired with an eagle eye for catching typos, awkward phrasing, or off-brand visuals. 
Tech-Forward Mindset: Familiarity with or eagerness to work alongside generative AI tools, digital asset libraries, and automated publishing platforms. 
Adaptability & Speed: Ability to switch contexts quickly between diverse industries—from plumbers and HVAC contractors to boutique retail and professional services. 


🌟 What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

En Panthr no somos una agencia de reclutamiento más. Somos el puente entre el talento con propósito y las empresas que necesitan resultados sin perder tiempo.

Conectamos a las personas correctas con las oportunidades correctas, sin rodeos y sin promesas que no se cumplen.

Serás responsable de acompañar a los clientes durante su experiencia con la plataforma, ayudándolos a resolver sus necesidades, aprovechar sus funcionalidades y obtener el máximo valor de la solución.

description:
Do work that matters.

At AlertMedia, we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed: 


We’re humans not robots 
Customers always come first 
We work better together 
Simplicity is our strength 
Our reputation is priceless 
Hard work pays off    


The Customer Success Specialist will take ownership of managing customer relationships, which we value above all else. This role will focus on emerging customers and partner closely with our Customer Support Team to foster success. In this key role, working closely with Customer Success, Customer Support, Marketing and Sales teams, they are responsible for driving engagement to support customer health, retention, and growth. The right candidate will be determined to achieve effective customer enablement, as well as the highest possible satisfaction rates across the accounts they manage. They will make sure customer needs are always met and problems are solved quickly.  

As one of the fastest growing software companies in the nation, we’re focused on finding the best talent and building the best team to continue accelerating our rapid growth to keep up with our demand!

Who you are:

You'd be excited to buy into our "customer love" mentality and are motivated by going above and beyond for the customers you serve. You are a team player, an individual contributor and have a roll-up-your-sleeves mentality when it comes to your customers and there is no task too big or too small to best support them. Support our customers in the SMB segment as a product expert to drive adoption and enable them to accomplish their goals

Host customer webinars and facilitate customer collaboration   
Align with the Customer Success organization to support initiatives to grow and expand existing accounts through adoption, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities

Contribute to AlertMedia’s culture, values, and vision for the future 
This is an individual contributor role and not a manager role

2+ years’ experience in customer success management or account management 
Experience in a Saas or Tech environment strongly preferred 
Salesforce or Hubspot experience preferred 
Strong organization and time management skills with ability to prioritize     
Comfort level managing a large volume of accounts     
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills     
Willingness to test and implement innovative ideas  
Experience with customer implementation and software adoption preferred  
Strong listening skills with  the ability to mirror and work with a variety of customer profiles      
Ability to work with all members of our team (customer support, business development, software development, and product management)     
Must be independent, self-motivated, success-driven, and adaptable        
The ability and desire to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment     
A vision for efficiency  
The desire to learn and be coached     
Bilingual English/Spanish a must 


Location: This is a hybrid position (2 days a week) in our downtown Mexico City (Reforma area) offices.

Competitive Base Salary
Annual Company Bonus
100% Employer-Paid Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Parental Leave Program 
Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo)
Generous Vacation and Holiday Policy
Monthly Work-from-Home Stipend

Language Immersion Program with employees spread out across the globe (English, Spanish, etc...depending on your interest)
Continuous Learning & Growth: From mentorship and tech talks to personalized 1:1 career development sessions, we’re deeply committed to investing in your professional journey
Award Winning Culture: We’re passionate about the meaningful work we do—and even more grateful for the incredible people we get to do it with!

We are the leading risk intelligence and response platform — trusted by the largest companies in the world to protect their people and assets when it matters most. description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. This position requires travel up to 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
Orchestrate renewal-focused business reviews with our customers where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
Mitigate escalations and resolve customer issues
Help Customers with a wide range of general inquiries and questions
Solve customer issues and escalations about Samsara products and services
Experience in multi-channel servicing including excellent phone skills and good writing skills for Web, email, and channel requests
Ability to prioritize work queue and backlog in addition to incoming customer requests
Provide excellent customer service throughout the service cycle from initial request to final close out of the transaction
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

2-5 years of experience in a Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Spanish and English fluency
IA tools fluency (Claude/ Pilot/ Gemini, others)

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization & automation, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Google Search Console, GA4, Looker Studio, Ahrefs, Semrush, Profound, SEOTesting, Screaming Frog or Sitebulb, PageSpeed Insights, WordPress, Airtable, ClickUp, and AI assistants and AI-powered SEO tools.

Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

You’ll partner closely with Client Leadership, senior channel colleagues, and additional channel teams (Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media) in your Pod, communicate clearly, and document what works so the team can reuse it. title: GTM Manager - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




GTM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Marketing

Marketing is at the heart of Reckitt. We pride ourselves on our unique way of driving growth for some of the world's most loved and trusted health, hygiene and nutrition brands. Our purpose and fight are what motivates us to design and deliver distinctive communications throughout our consumer funnel, so that we deliver category growth as well as a positive impact on society. With extensive media and digital teams embedded throughout the organisation, we measure both our business and our societal impact. Our global teams lead on our overarching brand strategy, brand guardianship and innovation pipeline in close partnership with R&D. Leaving our local marketing teams to deliver on our regional goals in partnership with our Sales teams. With the scale of our 2500 marketing community - alongside our leading-edge Marketing Academy - your opportunities to grow and upskill will be extensive.

About The Role

This role leads initiatives related to segmentation, targeting, territory design, incentive programs, sales target setting, and performance analytics.

The position works closely with Sales, Marketing, Professional Marketing, Finance, Insights & Analytics (I&A), and IT teams to drive sustainable organizational growth through data-driven decision-making.

Your responsibilities


Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of the sales force.
Implement dashboards and performance tracking tools to monitor results and drive informed decision-making.
Design and implement physician and pharmacy segmentation and targeting strategies.
Recommend adjustments to the commercial structure to enhance productivity and market coverage.
Manage performance measurement metrics and ensure accurate tracking of sales effectiveness.
Prepare prescription, market share, and productivity reports for commercial and detailing teams.
Administer and optimize CRM platforms and commercial support tools.

Media Buyer (Measurement & Creative Strategy)
About FX Replay




FX Replay is a B2C SaaS platform built for traders who want to improve through deliberate practice. More than 1 million traders use FX Replay to replay historical markets, test strategies against real price data, and review their trading decisions.

We're looking for a Media Buyer to own and scale paid acquisition, with Google Ads and Meta Ads as our core channels.

Your primary focus will be acquiring our defined ICP at the highest quality and lowest sustainable cost. We expect approximately 80% of your effort to go toward improving acquisition within this core audience, and 20% toward testing adjacent audiences, regions, and emerging opportunities such as CTV, OpenAI Ads, and other new channels.

This is not a role for someone who simply launches campaigns and optimizes toward what advertising platforms report. We are looking for a hands-on operator who can connect paid media performance to actual company outcomes, determine whether advertising is creating incremental growth, make informed budget allocation decisions, and turn performance insights into better creative.

You will operate at the intersection of paid acquisition, measurement, experimentation, creative strategy, and business performance.




What You'll Own
Paid Acquisition
Own paid acquisition strategy and hands-on execution across Google Ads and Meta Ads, from campaign structure and bidding to testing, optimization, and scaling.
Focus approximately 80% of your effort on acquiring our defined ICP at the highest quality and lowest sustainable cost, and 20% on testing adjacent audiences, regions, and emerging opportunities.
Build and maintain a structured testing roadmap across audiences, offers, landing pages, creatives, bidding approaches, and campaign structures.
Allocate and scale budgets based on CAC, LTV, payback, customer quality, and incremental business impact — not platform-reported ROAS alone.
Evaluate and test emerging acquisition channels such as CTV, OpenAI Ads, and other platforms when the opportunity and economics justify it.

Measurement & Incrementality
Connect advertising-platform performance with GA4, Google Tag Manager, BigQuery, and company-level customer and revenue data to understand actual business impact.
Measure acquisition beyond platform-reported CPA or ROAS, focusing on customer quality, paid conversion, revenue, CAC, LTV, payback, and incremental contribution.
Identify and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics, attribution systems, and internal company data.
Design and interpret incrementality tests, including holdouts, geo experiments, and lift studies, to determine which spend is actually driving new customers.
Challenge attribution and budget decisions when platform-reported performance does not align with actual company performance.

Creative Strategy & Performance
Own the creative performance loop from campaign data to the next creative test.
Identify winning and declining hooks, angles, messages, formats, offers, and audience insights from performance data.
Turn those insights into clear creative briefs, concepts, hooks, ad copy, and video scripts.
Direct and prioritize creative production with designers and video creators based on campaign needs, testing priorities, and performance.
Continuously test and iterate creative concepts, using performance data and AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, scripting, and learning.

How You'll Think About Performance




We expect you to look beyond advertising-platform metrics and understand the full acquisition system.

You should be comfortable evaluating performance through the metrics that matter most to customer quality and business impact:

Activation quality
Paid conversion
Revenue / MRR
LTV and payback
Incremental CAC

If Meta or Google reports strong performance while company revenue or MRR is moving in the opposite direction, we expect you to investigate why — not simply trust the platform attribution.


Responsibilities
Run paid acquisition hands-on every day, with Google Ads as the core channel, owning campaign structure, bidding, testing, optimization, and scaling.
Focus approximately 80% of your effort on acquiring our defined ICP at the highest quality and lowest sustainable cost, and 20% on testing adjacent audiences, regions, and emerging channels.
Allocate budget across channels and regions based on CAC, LTV, payback, customer quality, and incremental impact — not platform-reported ROAS alone.
Design and interpret incrementality tests, including holdouts, geo experiments, and lift studies, to determine which spend is actually driving new customers.

Report weekly on what happened, why it happened, what was learned, and what happens next, documenting experiments so successful approaches can be repeated and scaled.

5+ years of hands-on paid acquisition, media buying, or performance marketing experience, with deep Google Ads expertise and solid Meta Ads experience.
Proven experience managing and scaling paid media budgets of $100K+ per month.
Experience running paid acquisition under financial-services or other restricted-category advertising policies, including navigating compliance requirements and account restrictions.
Ability to connect advertising-platform performance to actual customer and revenue outcomes using GA4, GTM, and BigQuery, SQL, or comparable data environments.
Practical experience designing and interpreting incrementality tests, including holdouts, geo experiments, lift studies, or comparable methodologies.
Strong understanding of subscription economics, including CAC, cohort LTV, payback, and how acquisition performance translates into downstream revenue.
Strong creative judgment with experience turning performance insights into paid-media concepts, hooks, briefs, ad copy, and video scripts.
Experience in B2C SaaS, subscriptions, digital products, apps, fintech, trading, or comparable consumer acquisition funnels.

Google Ads and Meta Ads

 You consistently acquire our ICP at high quality and sustainable economics, understand which campaigns and channels are creating incremental customers, and know when platform attribution may be misleading.

Who We Are

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A Day In The Life

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients

skills: Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.
Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.
Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.
5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.
Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.
A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

Asimismo, actuará como referente interno y externo en plataformas digitales: evaluará nuevas plataformas y tecnologías alineadas con la visión del ecosistema digital, la innovación y la automatización; impulsará la madurez digital del cliente en México, y será soporte clave para los equipos regionales y globales.

Key responsibilities:


Definir la visión y estrategia de activación para las distintas plataformas de Paid Media del portafolio del cliente. 
Establecer metodologías, estándares operativos y mejores prácticas para todos los canales de activación digital. 
Revisar la estrategia con el equipo de Planning y brindar consultoría oportuna en briefs, con propuestas tácticas y estratégicas entregadas en tiempo y forma. 
Garantizar que las estrategias de medios estén alineadas con los objetivos de negocio del cliente y que sus guidelines y benchmarks se apliquen correctamente en la planeación táctica por plataforma. 
Impulsar la innovación y adopción de nuevas capacidades, formatos y tecnologías publicitarias, evaluando plataformas alineadas con la visión del ecosistema digital. 
Supervisar la evolución del ecosistema digital e identificar oportunidades para generar ventajas competitivas. 
Construir y ejecutar el roadmap de acciones para elevar el score de madurez digital del portafolio en México. 
Supervisar el uso y desempeño de plataformas como Google Ads, DV360, CM360, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Amazon Ads y otras soluciones relevantes. 
Coordinar la implementación digital de las campañas cross-channel del portafolio, con herramientas y técnicas que permitan el correcto seguimiento de los proyectos. 
Garantizar la correcta implementación, optimización y medición de campañas, integrando el framework de medición y data collection en todas las plataformas de anuncios. 
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares de calidad, gobernanza y control de inversiones. 
Liderar iniciativas de automatización, integración tecnológica y mejora continua. 
Desarrollar frameworks de optimización y eficiencia para maximizar el rendimiento de las campañas. 
Dirigir y desarrollar un equipo de especialistas de alto rendimiento (Search, Social, Programmatic/DSP, Retail Media, data e innovación). 
Establecer objetivos individuales, indicadores de desempeño y planes de desarrollo y carrera para cada integrante. 
Identificar necesidades de capacitación y fomentar la formación continua y certificaciones en plataformas y tendencias del mercado. 
Participar en reuniones de alto nivel y acompañar al equipo de cuentas en la presentación de estrategias, planes digitales, resultados y oportunidades de crecimiento. 
Traducir objetivos de negocio en soluciones de activación digital escalables y rentables. 
Construir, junto con las áreas involucradas, una operación limpia y best-in-class en el mercado mexicano, documentando y presentando casos de éxito. 
Ser punto de soporte del mercado México para los equipos regionales y globales. 
Construir relaciones sólidas con stakeholders internos, clientes y partners tecnológicos. 
Diseñar propuestas innovadoras que integren capacidades de Paid Media y tecnología. 
Desarrollar nuevas ofertas de servicio y capacidades especializadas para responder a las necesidades del mercado. 
Mantener relaciones estratégicas con plataformas, partners y proveedores tecnológicos. 
Supervisar la rentabilidad y eficiencia operativa de las áreas bajo su responsabilidad. 
Gestionar forecasting, planeación de recursos y capacidad de los equipos. 
Asegurar el cumplimiento de acuerdos comerciales, SLAs y compromisos con clientes. 



Minimum requirements:


Lic. concluida en Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Comunicación, Administración, Negocios, Ingeniería o áreas afines. 
Diplomados en marketing digital (deseable). 
Certificaciones vigentes en plataformas publicitarias digitales (altamente valoradas). 
Inglés avanzado. 
Mínimo 8 años de experiencia en medios digitales, marketing de performance o activación de campañas digitales, en distintas verticales de negocio. 
Al menos 5 años liderando equipos de Paid Media o áreas de activación digital. 
Sólida experiencia en planeación y estrategia digital multicanal para clientes nacionales e internacionales. 
Experiencia gestionando presupuestos de inversión publicitaria de gran escala. 
Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinarios y estructuras regionales o globales. 
Experiencia participando en pitches, desarrollo de negocio y crecimiento de cuentas. 
Deseable experiencia en agencias de medios, agencias digitales o consultoría de marketing. 
Dominio del ecosistema de Paid Media: Search, Social, Programmatic, Video, Retail Media y medición digital. 
Campañas de branding y performance: implementación, medición, atribución y análisis de desempeño. 
Entendimiento de KPIs y benchmarks digitales; optimización basada en datos. 
Automatización, bidding strategies, audiencias avanzadas y tecnologías publicitarias. 
Herramientas de medición y audiencias en medios. 
Privacidad digital, first-party data y tendencias de la industria. 
Proceso creativo y de medios; capacidad para crear, adaptar y asegurar el cumplimiento de procesos.

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

As a Commerce Media Specialist, you will support the execution and optimization of marketing campaigns within the commerce media ecosystem. You will leverage your growing expertise to drive client success through effective campaign management, performance tracking, and collaboration with internal teams.

Client-Centric:

Key Responsibilities:


Build, drive, and optimize successful Walmart DSP marketing campaigns within your specialty and channel to meet and exceed client goals, measured by campaign performance metrics such as conversion rates and ROI.
Foster rapport with clients through weekly interactions via phone, email, and in-person meetings (as needed), striving for a Client Satisfaction score of 9 or above and Client Retention of 95% or above. 


Product-Led::

Data & Measurement Data-Driven:

Communicate holistic strategy behind your clients’ KPIs by interpreting trends and leveraging cross-channel data/insights within your purview.


Channel Specific Expertise & The Tinuiti Way:


Proactively assess and diagnose opportunities for improvement, implementing changes to achieve growth, retention, and profitability targets for your clients.
Identify new marketing opportunities and ways to repurpose existing strategies to optimize brand awareness and drive sales volume across commerce media platforms.
Demonstrate thought leadership within your vertical/channel and the broader commerce media landscape, contributing insights internally and externally.


Owner Mindset:


Effectively prioritize and manage time across clients, partner relationships, and internal initiatives, ensuring timely delivery of tasks and objectives.
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by experimenting with new strategies and tools, measured by the implementation of innovative solutions and client feedback.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications:


2-3 of experience in commerce media or digital advertising roles with a proven track record of executing successful campaigns with monthly budgets of $20k+
Familiarity with commerce media platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, Criteo, etc.
Familiarity with tools such as Skai, Helium10, and Analytic Index a plus

Buscamos una persona analítica, organizada y orientada a resultados, con capacidad para gestionar múltiples campañas e iniciativas simultáneamente, interpretar indicadores de desempeño y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios.

description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The Marketing team formulates the brand and company's marketing strategy — across market channels, brand marketing and media — and drives the campaigns and research that grow the business and strengthen our influence with the industry and our users.

As Senior Brand Manager for Mobility in LATAM, you'll own the brand and marketing strategy for the Mobility business across the region and lead a talented team to deliver it. This is a strategic leadership role: you set regional brand direction, own the fiscal-year plan and budget, and act as the bridge between marketing and senior business stakeholders — turning Mobility's business objectives into a coherent, market-relevant strategy your team can execute across LATAM markets.

In this role, you'll be...

Connect the business ambition to the brand vision, developing a strong brand positioning that delivers high user-impact and value


Owning and designing the marketing strategy for Mobility, translating business OKRs, user insights and sources of growth into an actionable fiscal-year plan and roadmap that goes beyond tactical campaigns — increasing market share and positioning DiDi as the preferred brand
Understanding the local market (LATAM) — competitors, trends, regulation and macro context — and shaping strategy around their implications for the brand and business
Leading strategic, complex marketing projects with multiple internal and external partners, aligned to brand and business goals
Owning full budget responsibility within your scope, including forecasting, prioritization and resource allocation
Leading metric systems and analytical frameworks, and championing a data-driven culture across the team
Ensuring brand consistency across touchpoints and over time, and proactively addressing complex brand issues
Serving as the point of contact for business teams and communicating with senior leaders
Leading your team: setting and tracking goals, running performance reviews, coaching, building IDPs, and developing talent
Translating the strategic vision into clear direction and acting as a role model of company values



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Strong strategic thinking — you look past the surface to the core of a problem, think creatively beyond your function, and take a long-term, big-picture view
Proven experience owning a full-year brand and marketing strategy end-to-end for a business or region, not just executing campaigns
Excellent briefing skills — able to translate deep insights and strategy into outstanding briefs
Experience leading a talented team with direct reports, including performance management and talent development
Solid brand-building expertise, with strong command of marketing methodology and tools and understanding of adjacent areas (media, research, creative, attribution model)
Experience across LATAM markets and the ability to balance regional consistency with local relevance
Data fluency — comfortable building and improving analytical frameworks and driving decisions from insight
Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management, able to influence decisions and align cross-functional teams
Experience owning a marketing budget, staretgy and plan end-to-end
Resilience, a growth mindset, and self-driven passion for results
Experience in tech or fast-paced digital companies is a plus — not mandatory.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role of a Partner Marketing Manager at Canonical

Canonical is looking for a channel marketing manager who will be responsible for developing our strategic relationships with a set of global partners . Canonical partners with the leading companies in technology across public cloud (Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Oracle…), silicon (ARM, Intel, Qualcomm, Mediatek, Nvidia, Xilinx…), hardware vendors (Dell, HP, HPE, Lenovo). As our business increasingly depends on partners, the scope of our partnership grows every year (GSI, software vendors, IoT…). We are thus looking for an individual, who will not only drive successful marketing activities with our partners but also shape our partner programs.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

This role reports to the Head of Partner Marketing.

Location:This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

What your day will look like


Build joint go-to-market plans with partners, from messaging to pipeline generation
Create and deliver integrated campaigns, product launches, webinar series, industry announcements and core content in collaboration with partners.
Package all of Canonical's product offerings and educational material creatively, from bare metal, AI, Kubernetes...
Continue to grow Canonical's partner ecosystem by delivering partner value
Continue to develop Canonical's partner activities to scale our partner programs



What we are looking for in you


Experience in B2B marketing and experience working with strategic corporate partners to develop co-marketing initiatives. 
Strong customer/partner relationship management skills.
Proven analytical skills, able to assess opportunities and make decisions on ROI/advantages of programs & investments.
Willingness to roll up their sleeves.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.



Nice-to-have Skills


Experience in enterprise software, SaaS or silicon preferred
Track record of delivering strong results and innovation.
Ability to work and thrive in a self-starter, fast-paced and changing environment
Love for diverse work assignments and the opportunity to try new approaches
Growth mindset - someone who is not afraid to think big and take on risk.



What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

As part of the Trade Marketing team, the Trade Marketing Coordinator for Mexico will support the execution and follow-up of trade marketing initiatives across retail accounts. This role will coordinate with vendors, sales, clients, and the promoter team to ensure the successful execution of projects and in-store activities aligned with brand and commercial objectives in Mexico.

The Trade Marketing Coordinator will be responsible for managing vendors, working closely with the commercial team, and maintaining strong relationships with retail clients. This role will oversee the promoter’s teams for accounts, ensuring proper coverage, training, execution, and performance through defined KPIs. The coordinator will have budget control of his accounts, project coordination, and follow-up, development and execution of POP materials and displays, as well as in-store activations and retail events. Additionally, this role will analyze post-project results to identify opportunities and provide insights for future activations and continuous improvement.

What You Will Do


Help drive the trade marketing execution in Mexico
Project coordination: Coordinate the end-to-end execution of Trade Marketing projects, from briefing and planning to implementation and follow-up, working closely with vendors, Sales, retail clients, and the promoter team.

title: Gestión de la Comunicación Interna LATAM
description:
Sobre NTT DATA




Haz de este el lugar donde crezcas.

Como líder global en innovación empresarial y tecnológica, trabajamos con las mejores organizaciones a nivel mundial para entregar soluciones que generan un impacto significativo. 

Con más de 190,000 profesionales en más de 70 países, combinamos un profundo conocimiento con una cultura que valora el aprendizaje, la curiosidad y la colaboración. 

Lideramos la transformación y entregamos soluciones seguras, innovadoras y específicas de la industria que impulsan el crecimiento de los negocios. Nuestra gente impulsa todos nuestros logros, piensan en grande para entregar resultados mientras se asegura que cada voz sea escuchada. 




¿Qué buscamos?

• Experiencia sólida en comunicación interna, comunicación corporativa o funciones afines, idealmente con alcance regional o multinacional.

• Experiencia desarrollando y ejecutando estrategias y campañas de comunicación interna alineadas con objetivos de negocio y de la organización.

• Experiencia coordinando iniciativas de engagement y comunicación regional desde su conceptualización hasta la ejecución y medición de resultados.

• Conocimiento en gestión de procesos, flujos y modelos de gobernanza de comunicación interna.

• Experiencia administrando y optimizando canales de comunicación interna y plataformas digitales corporativas.

• Excelentes habilidades de redacción, edición y revisión de contenidos institucionales, guiones, mensajes ejecutivos y otros materiales de comunicación.

• Experiencia en planificación y coordinación de eventos internos regionales y corporativos, como All-Hands y encuentros ejecutivos.

• Capacidad para relacionarse y coordinarse con equipos de diferentes países, manteniendo consistencia de mensajes y adaptación a contextos locales.

• Alta capacidad de organización, gestión de múltiples iniciativas, orientación a resultados y excelentes habilidades de comunicación e influencia.




¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?

• Desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos de comunicación interna alineados con los objetivos de comunicación de IBIOL y de la compañía.

• Gestionar, coordinar y monitorear campañas regionales de comunicación interna, asegurando consistencia de mensajes, cumplimiento de plazos y medición de resultados.

• Liderar la producción y gestión de iniciativas regionales de engagement y comunicación, desde la conceptualización hasta su ejecución.

• Gestionar los procesos, flujos y gobernanza de la comunicación interna, impulsando eficiencia y buenas prácticas en la región.

• Administrar y optimizar los canales de comunicación interna, promoviendo su uso estratégico y efectivo.

• Producir, revisar y aprobar contenidos editoriales, incluyendo textos institucionales, guiones de video y mensajes ejecutivos, garantizando calidad, claridad y alineación de tono.

• Desarrollar y gestionar la comunicación de eventos internos regionales y corporativos, incluyendo la planificación, producción de contenidos y coordinación de canales.

• Mantener una relación cercana y continua con los equipos de comunicación interna de los diferentes países de LATAM, facilitando la coordinación regional.

• Actuar como punto focal regional en comités de gestión de People y Comunicación Interna junto con NTT DATA Inc.




Este rol describe tu punto de partida en NTT DATA. Creemos en las relaciones a largo plazo y en apoyar tu desarrollo. A medida que tus habilidades y ambiciones evolucionen, trabajaremos contigo para identificar futuras oportunidades, proyectos y carreras profesionales dentro de nuestra organización. 




🌟 ¿Por qué NTT DATA?

🤝 Una cultura de colaboración y apoyo

Fomentamos un entorno donde la curiosidad, la innovación, el compromiso y el trabajo en equipo son celebrados. Nuestra filosofía de “People first” es una de las razones principales por las que continuamos siendo reconocidos globalmente. 

🚀 Desarrollo profesional y aprendizaje continuo

Accede a un camino de formación estructurado, recursos de aprendizaje continuos, revisiones de desempeño anuales y un programa de mentoría dedicado — todo diseñado para ayudarte a desarrollarte profesionalmente y asumir nuevos desafíos. 

💻 Equilibrio entre vida laboral y personal apoyado por nuestra política BeFlex 

Como empresa, adoptamos un enfoque BeFlex que empodera a nuestra gente con flexibilidad para gestionar su jornada laboral.

✨ Top Empleador Global 

Estamos orgullosamente certificados como Top Empleador Global, que refleja nuestro compromiso de ser un lugar donde las personas puedan desarrollarse y prosperar. 

🌿 Salud y bienestar primero

Tu bienestar mental importa. Los empleados tienen acceso a psicólogos certificados y talleres de salud mental en línea. 

🌈 Diversidad, Equidad e Inclusión

Estamos comprometidos a crear un lugar de trabajo donde todos puedan prosperar, sin importar género, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o contexto. La inclusión es parte de quiénes somos y cómo trabajamos. 

#WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique 

Al recibir una entrevista, puedes solicitar adaptaciones para cualquier necesidad de accesibilidad. 

¿Suena interesante? Aplica ahora o comparte con un amigo 🔹




Nuestros Beneficios

Sueldo competitivo, acorde a tu experiencia y conocimientos, en un esquema 100% nómina.

Prestaciones de ley.

Formación técnica y certificaciones.
